facts.text: UT Knoxville guarantees admission to in-state students who apply by its early action deadlines and meet set requirements.
The Tri-Star Scholarship Program combines awards including Pledge, Promise, and Flagship to cover full in-state tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Tennessee students.

sources.title: Your Guide to Affording the University of Tennessee, Knoxville

facts.text: The Distinguished Tennessean Award covers full tuition and mandatory fees for one standout student from each of Tennessee's 95 counties.
